// normal function that writes its result into a dedicated global.
// Entry's compare block coerces numeric-looking strings, then uses a loose !=.

// 0 a freshly loaded variable starts at, and the slot never clears. BLANK is a
// zero-width space: it renders as nothing but is never equal to a number.

// and the results tables line up.

// an overcast, wet day: a low grey sky and the far field lost in spray

// ---- 4b) derived per-segment flags, and jump ramps ----

// ...then spread from a little before the corner to well past its exit,

let q = mod(i - 1 - k + NSEG, NSEG) + 1;
let x = sgX[i]; let y = sgY[i]; let z = sgZ[i];
let nx = sgNX[i]; let nz = sgNZ[i];
wvX[base + P_L] = x - nx * w; wvY[base + P_L] = yL; wvZ[base + P_L] = z - nz * w;
wvX[base + P_R] = x + nx * w; wvY[base + P_R] = yR; wvZ[base + P_R] = z + nz * w;

wvX[base + P_CR] = x + nx * cw; wvY[base + P_CR] = y - bc + 0.06; wvZ[base + P_CR] = z + nz * cw;

// longest run of near-straight rings not yet claimed
// start the scan just after a bend so no run is split by the lap line
if (run > bestN) { bestN = run; bestS = runS; }
// grid slots: rows of two, three rings apart, behind the line

// A minimum-curvature line: each ring's lateral offset is pulled toward the

// corner), then near ones (smoothing). rlO is the offset from the centreline.
let mx = (sgX[p] + sgNX[p] * rlO[p] + sgX[q] + sgNX[q] * rlO[q]) * 0.5;
let mz = (sgZ[p] + sgNZ[p] * rlO[p] + sgZ[q] + sgNZ[q] * rlO[q]) * 0.5;

// curvature of the line itself, from the rings two either side
let ax = sgX[p] + sgNX[p] * rlO[p]; let az = sgZ[p] + sgNZ[p] * rlO[p];
let bx = sgX[i] + sgNX[i] * rlO[i]; let bz = sgZ[i] + sgNZ[i] * rlO[i];
let cx = sgX[q] + sgNX[q] * rlO[q]; let cz = sgZ[q] + sgNZ[q] * rlO[q];
// circle through three points: k = 2 sin(angle) / chord
let ux = bx - ax; let uz = bz - az;
let vx = cx - bx; let vz = cz - bz;
let wx2 = cx - ax; let wz2 = cz - az;
let cr = ux * vz - uz * vx;
let la = Math.sqrt((ux * ux + uz * uz) * (vx * vx + vz * vz) * (wx2 * wx2 + wz2 * wz2));
// The speed the racing line can be driven at by a car of the given grip
// and top speed: corner speeds from the line's curvature, then braking
// zones worked backwards from every corner (twice round, for the wrap).
// Scattered once per circuit, deterministically, so a track always looks the
// same. Every object is filed under the segment it stands beside; the renderer
// then draws it with that segment's draw unit, which is what makes the
// painter's algorithm sort it against the road and the cars for free.
// place one object `dist` metres out from the centreline of segment i
function scPut(i, side, dist, type, scale, matOff, lod) {
// stood square to the track by default
// same, but turned to face the road
function scPutFacing(i, side, dist, type, scale, matOff, lod) {
scPut(i, side, dist, type, scale, matOff, lod);
// the circuit's own named buildings, placed before anything else so they

if (md == 1) { scPutFacing(i, lmSide[k], lmDist[k], lmType[k], lmK[k], lmMat[k], 0); }
else { scPut(i, lmSide[k], lmDist[k], lmType[k], lmK[k], lmMat[k], 0); }
// one piece of the theme's filler at distance d on the given side
function scFill(theme, i, side, d, roll, sc, near) {
// Monaco: apartment blocks in cream and ochre, palms along the front
if (roll < 0.42) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_TOWER, 0.7 + sc * 0.5, 4 * mod(i, 2), 0); }
else if (roll < 0.70) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_SHED, sc * 1.5, 4 * mod(i + 1, 2), 0); }
else if (roll < 0.86) { scPut(i, side, near, SC_PALM, sc, 0, 1); }
// Spa: the Ardennes - pine forest right up to the circuit
if (roll < 0.66) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_PINE, sc * 1.15, 0, 1); }
else if (roll < 0.84) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_OAK, sc, 0, 1); }
else if (roll < 0.90) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_ROCK, sc, 0, 1); }
// Suzuka: trees, hedged fields and the odd farmhouse

else if (roll < 0.62) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_PINE, sc, 0, 1); }
else if (roll < 0.74) { scPutFacing(i, side, d, SC_HEDGE, 1, 0, 1); }
else if (roll < 0.84) { scPut(i, side, d + 30, SC_SHED, sc * 0.8, 4 * mod(i, 4), 0); }
// Silverstone: an open airfield - hedges, hospitality tents, a few trees
else if (roll < 0.40) { scPut(i, side, d + 20, SC_TENT, sc * 1.3, 0, 1); }
else if (roll < 0.58) { scPut(i, side, d + 20, SC_OAK, sc, 0, 1); }
else if (roll < 0.64) { scPut(i, side, d + 60, SC_SHED, sc, 8, 0); }
// Monza: the royal park, tall broadleaf trees everywhere

else if (roll < 0.86) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_PINE, sc * 1.2, 0, 1); }

else if (roll < 0.66) { scPut(i, side, d, SC_SHED, sc * 1.6, 8 + 4 * mod(i + 1, 2), 0); }

dx = x - sgX[best]; dz = z - sgZ[best];
dx = x - sgX[best]; dz = z - sgZ[best];
// banking tilts the surface across the track

let edgeY = y - (sfT > 0 ? w : 0 - w) * tand(bank);
// render.js - perspective renderer on Entry's pen-fill primitive.
//   * one flat vertex buffer: track rings, then car vertices, then scratch
//   * per-frame: cull segments (distance + frustum) -> depth sort ->
//     project only the rings that survive -> painter's fill back-to-front
//   * near-plane clipping (Sutherland-Hodgman), back-face culling by signed

const SMOKEZ = 3.0;        // puffs nearer than this would swallow the screen
const CULLBACK = 4;        // rings scanned behind the camera
const SCNM = 120;          // scenery reaches this far out, so cull wider
let cfX = 0; let cfY = 0; let cfZ = 1;      // forward
let crX = 1; let crY = 0; let crZ = 0;      // right
let cuX = 0; let cuY = 1; let cuZ = 0;      // up
let chX = 0; let chZ = 1;                   // forward, flattened
let csX = 1; let csZ = 0;                   // right, flattened
let colOff = 0;             // colTab base, folded: colTab[colOff + mat * NFOG + fog]
let qHex = '#000000';       // quad(..., mat < 0) fills with this colour instead

let scnHi2 = 3600;          // ...and uses its full model inside this
let carLodM2 = 14400;       // silhouette car model inside this, a card beyond

let bx = psX[b]; let by = psY[b];
let cx = psX[c]; let cy = psY[c];

// flat screen-space quad in a literal colour (sky bands, HUD panels)
function fill4(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4, col) {

fill4(hx - dx, hy - dy, hx + dx, hy + dy,
hx + dx - nx * 900, hy + dy - ny * 900, hx - dx - nx * 900, hy - dy - ny * 900,
// sky: bands from the horizon colour up to a deeper tone

hx + dx + nx * o1, hy + dy + ny * o1, hx - dx + nx * o1, hy - dy + ny * o1,

hx + cr * t1, hy - sr * t1,
hx + cr * t1 + sr * y1, hy - sr * t1 + cr * y1,
hx + cr * t0 + sr * y0, hy - sr * t0 + cr * y0, col);

quad(b0 + P_GL, b0 + P_L, b1 + P_L, b1 + P_GL, sgGMat[i]);
quad(b0 + P_R, b0 + P_GR, b1 + P_GR, b1 + P_R, sgGMat[i]);

quad(b0 + P_GL, b0 + P_OL, b1 + P_OL, b1 + P_GL, sgGMat[i]);

let bx = psX[b0 + P_R]; let by = psY[b0 + P_R];

cx + (dx - cx) * t1, cy + (dy - cy) * t1, cx + (dx - cx) * t0, cy + (dy - cy) * t0, m, dep);

let ax = psX[b0 + P_L]; let ay = psY[b0 + P_L];
let bx = psX[b0 + P_R] - ax; let by = psY[b0 + P_R] - ay;
let cx = psX[b1 + P_L]; let cy = psY[b1 + P_L];
let dx = psX[b1 + P_R] - cx; let dy = psY[b1 + P_R] - cy;
quadS(ax + bx * e0, ay + by * e0, ax + bx * e1, ay + by * e1,
cx + dx * e1, cy + dy * e1, cx + dx * e0, cy + dy * e0, M_startA, dep);
quadS(ax + bx * f0, ay + by * f0, ax + bx * f1, ay + by * f1,
cx + dx * f1, cy + dy * f1, cx + dx * f0, cy + dy * f0, M_startA, dep);
// Racing-line assist: a strip along the line, green where you can keep
// accelerating, amber where you should lift, red where you are too fast for
// what is coming and must brake.
let ax = psX[b0 + P_L]; let ay = psY[b0 + P_L];
let bx = psX[b0 + P_R] - ax; let by = psY[b0 + P_R] - ay;
